## Why visit

The clearest Salford anchor for a visit driven by cask variety. Its corner-pub rooms and restored snug provide a proper pub setting for a substantial changing range, while the Belgian bottle offering gives experienced drinkers another reason to linger. This is a place to ask about the darker cask and the freshest regional beer rather than simply defaulting to the best-known permanent name. Combine it with Kings Arms and Eagle Inn for three distinct versions of Salford pub life, or use Black Friar nearby for a meal.

## Beer

CAMRA records eleven handpumps with regional changing ales and usually a dark beer; a large Belgian beer range complements them.
